name: East Coast VS West Coast

features.name: Drive-By Respins
features.description: Two bonus symbols award a respin with an enhancer.

review:
East Coast VS West Coast is a 5x3 hip-hop rivalry slot with two free spins modes. Two bonus symbols trigger a Drive-By Respin, borrowing one enhancer from either coast.

East Coast Spins land Infectious xWays every spin, while West Coast Spins give each spin one of xWays, xNudge Wilds, multipliers or linked reels. Landing enough for both leads to Coast to Coast. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with a 30,618x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
